integrity: Proof is analytical; the finite symbolic checker is supplementary. Scientific priority and mathematical correctness have not been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Two distinct interior Hamming layers, quadratic Walsh band, positive mixing weights only. Rank-one radial loss. No optimal layer/weight selection or higher-order claim. Finite computational checks corroborate algebraic proof; novelty assessment remains provisional.
title: Exact quadratic Walsh sampling spectra on arbitrary weighted pairs of Hamming layers
